cells.name: keltron_version
cells.lb: for SATs of Echo Sounder Keltron V

cells.value: as per IHQ MoD (N) approved schedule. Following observed:-
Check 6.3.1 - Switching ON the Echo Sounder.
Check 6.3.2 - Depth reading checks at harbour
Check 6.3.3 - Check the LED / VGA repeater Unit display readings.
Check 6.3.5 - Depth reading checks at various depths and different speed upto 1500 mtrs.
Check 6.3.6 - Check the distance mark on the chart while monitoring the distance reading at the LOG speed
Check 6.3.7 - Check the USB Printer is connected and take a print.
Interface checks with ECDIS and other equipment (if applicable).
Shallow water alarms may be verified at shallow waters of upto 10m depth.
Check both Dual Channel (if applicable) and Single Channel operation in Auto Mode only.
